_comment: Registry of client-visible surfaces. visibility_audit.py reads this to
diff what the Notion hub shows against what data/ actually holds.
Hand-maintained: adding a Notion page or an embed means adding it here,
and an HTML file in the repo that appears on no page is reported as
unreferenced rather than silently assumed live.

pages.status_note: Built 2026-08-26. The Notion page that embeds it cannot be created until this branch merges and GitHub Pages deploys the file, because an embed pointing at a 404 is worse than no page. Creating that page and adding its URL here is the remaining manual step.

unreferenced_expected.index.html: Standalone landing page kept for direct linking; it duplicates the Complete Centers surfaces and is on no Notion page. Reported, not a defect.

ai_centers.csv: Same: visible with provenance, still a hand-placed snapshot with no refresh path.
atlas.csv: Provenance now ships with the page (rows, repository change date, and the fact that the upstream vintage is unrecorded). What is still missing is acquisition: nothing refreshes this file. Pass 3.
change_log.csv: Row-level change log written by the cleaner. Provenance, not product.
data/adjacency_scan_summary.json: Spillover scan summary; needs a defensibility read before it faces a client.
Layer discovery output. Unresolved: needs a one-time manual pin.
data/attributable_delay.md: Opposition-attributable delay is permanently gated per IDENTIFIABILITY.md. Never surfaced at any sample size.
data/audit_data_flags.csv: Validation problems raised by the audit analysis layer.
data/audit_discovered_opposition.csv: Audit findings queued for collection into master_opposition.csv.
data/baseline_dated.csv: Dated control arm for the same gated comparison.
data/baseline_dated_external.csv: External dated rows staged for the control arm.
data/baseline_dated_external_rejects.csv: Rows the staging step rejected, kept for audit.
data/baseline_universe.csv: The unopposed comparison pool. Its size is a denominator worth showing; its rows are Layer E and never a source of record.
data/bill_sync_matches.csv: Statewide legislation matched to the tracker; the stage ladder is the client-legible part.
data/bill_sync_votes.csv: Roll-call detail behind the stage ladder.
data/calibration_history.csv: Rolled into data/operations_summary.json and shown on the Data Operations page.
data/control_comparison.md: Balance diagnostics for the gated comparison.
data/cost_translation_demo.csv: Cost layer is deferred until a promotable model exists to translate; cost_layer_notes.md governs.
data/county_census_features.csv: ACS and Gazetteer feature input to the county model.
data/county_fips_overlay.csv: Manual FIPS corrections layered over the resolver.
data/county_policy_intervals.csv: Venn-Abers intervals; the scoring page asserts calibrated uncertainty without showing it.
data/coverage_gap_report.csv: Per-county gap detail behind the recall headline.
data/coverage_gap_summary.json: Rolled into data/operations_summary.json and shown on the Data Operations page.
data/dated_comparison.md: Opposed-versus-unopposed delay comparison. Reads as an attributable-delay claim, which IDENTIFIABILITY.md permanently gates.
data/dispute_watch.csv: Litigation watch for cases that could flip an outcome.
data/emergence_analysis.md: Emergence gate criteria and stratum coverage.
data/emergence_bounds.csv: Per-stratum coverage shown on the Data Operations page; the bounds themselves stay internal until the random stratum is nonzero.
data/external_restriction_census.csv: The external lower bound recall is measured against. Shown as a source and a count, never as a source of record.
data/facility_candidates.csv: Layer A pre-promotion intake from the signal harvester. Nothing here is a source of record.
data/facility_manifest.json: Provenance table shown on the Data Operations page and inline on the Infrastructure surfaces.
data/gap_promotion_report.csv: Rolled into data/operations_summary.json and shown on the Data Operations page.
data/group_registry_audit.csv: Audit over a permanently internal file.
data/group_registry_audit_summary.json: Audit over a permanently internal file.
data/incentive_execution_risk_proxy.md: Proxy diagnostic, not reviewed for external framing.
data/landmark_diagnostics.md: Why the landmark gate is closed and which recoveries move a frame. The honest roadmap for the lifecycle product.
data/landmark_feasibility.csv: Per-window gate table shown on the Data Operations page.
data/landmark_model_report.md: Gate status and per-window frame counts are the honest roadmap for the lifecycle product.
data/landmark_recovery_priority.csv: Ranks the 46 outstanding decision dates by whether recovery moves a frame.
data/layer_audit.csv: Dataset barrier audit. Findings are for maintainers; a client has no use for a writer map.
data/local_meeting_feed.csv: Earliest-signal feed; needs a defensibility read before it faces a client.
data/matched_controls.csv: Matched pairs support the same gated comparison and invite it if surfaced.
data/national_restriction_worklist.csv: Row counts and task classes shown on the Data Operations page; the rows themselves stay internal.
data/negative_audit_codings.csv: Coding sheet for the verified-negative audit. Rows carry researcher notes.
data/operations_summary.json: Single small artifact the operations page loads, written by operations_summary.py from the audit trails.
data/outcome_model_features.csv: The outcome and survival models are internal diagnostics framed with wide intervals and small-sample limits, and neither is client facing (README, Phase 3 detail).
data/outcome_model_predictions.csv: Same ruling. Project-level predicted probabilities do not leave the repository until the calibration gate promotes a model.
data/political_alignment_proxy.md: Proxy diagnostic, not reviewed for external framing.
data/project_decision_dates.csv: Hand-maintained verified dates, each with a source and URL. An input, not an output.
data/proposals_added.csv: Scraper delta against the project registry.
data/proposals_manual_overlay.csv: Hand-maintained overlay on the project registry.
data/restriction_ingest_candidates.md: Pre-promotion candidates. Nothing here is a source of record.
data/restriction_worklist.md: Ranked collection and reconciliation work. Counts may be surfaced; rows are internal.
data/signal_promotion_report.csv: Rolled into data/operations_summary.json and shown on the Data Operations page. The raw trail is two megabytes and stays server side.
data/site_screen.csv: Site screening scores; not yet reviewed for external framing.
data/site_screen_history.csv: Screening history; same review as site_screen.csv.
data/site_screen_movers.md: Week-over-week movers; same review as site_screen.csv.
data/splink_spike_eval.csv: Probabilistic linkage spike, NO-GO on adoption 2026-07-28; retained as a manual disagreement-audit tool only.
data/stale_pending_summary.json: Rolled into data/operations_summary.json and shown on the Data Operations page.
data/subframe_audit_tva.csv: Per-county detail behind the TVA frame audit.
data/subframe_audit_tva.md: Frame audits are a client-legible completeness claim per named subframe.
Per-county detail behind the Vantage frame audit.
group_registry.csv: Group-level outcome columns are permanently internal at any sample size (2026-07-30 ruling): they attribute project outcomes to named organizations with no control group.
headline_metrics.md: The platform's own headline numbers are generated on every run and appear on no page.

disposition_rules: Human review queue. Counts may be surfaced; rows are internal.
